# Camp Resource: Fishing Cooler Cryo Freezer

Keep your fish on ice with this Cryo Freezer.

It will instantly freeze food and drink items, reducing spoilage rates to 0%.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Fishing Cooler Cryo Freezer__

**Produces**

Stops your food and drink from spoiling

For the few moments it takes for your camp to load into a server, food and drink are not yet assigned to the Cryo-Freezer, so they may begin to spoil. Spoiling will stop as soon as your camp finishes loading in.

If you load into a server and cannot place your camp, items stored in the Cryo-Freezer will be moved to your stash box and begin to spoil. If you switch camps, make sure the new camp also has a Cryo-Freezer—otherwise, your food and drink will remain in your stash and continue to spoil.

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Cryo Freezer

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Appliances

**Materials required to craft resource**

5x Circuitry

3x Copper

2x Rubber

2x Steel

**Holds**

50 items.

It uses your stash box weight, but it can only access your food/drink tab in your stash box.

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
